Name: Assir, Son of Ebiasaph
Summary: Son of Ebiasaph and father of Tahath in the Kohathite line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:23: Son of Ebiasaph and father of Tahath in the Kohathite line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Assir stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
